summary: A18 delivered a single 1600x1000 three-act image in which the same 15 units (5 blue, 5 orange, 5 grey, d36) appear unchanged in all three acts while the story moves from one attracting centre to an overloaded single node to an equal redistribution across three nodes. The Transform matrix syntax was settled by four real probes rather than guesswork (three deliberate 400s with retained bodies, one 200 that pinned down column-major parentheses form), and the matrix rule itself came from a retained document reused from A17, so this task issued no document requests at all. Two narrative compositions were each rendered as a real 1600x1000 preview before either was chosen, both are kept in tmp, and composition A (horizontal bands) was selected by viewing them side by side. Five complete visual iterations followed, each driven by actually opening the image: band height and label placement, a core/shell read in act 1, a colour-segregation bug that quietly broke the 'not inferable from colour alone' rule, a tangency of 0.2 px found by measurement, act-label sizing for the required 400 px check, and finally a hidden-link defect an independent viewer reported (13 of 15 connectors visible) that was fixed by moving the act-2 rings while keeping cross-ring spacing at 38.59 px. 12 requests (9x200, 3x400 probe failures, 30.0 s of accepted-render time, 778,619 bytes received), 21 iteration rows with 5 complete visual iterations and 5 distinct defects found by viewing, 17 real image-view events including 4 independent full-size verifications, both required composition previews plus every refinement retained in tmp, and a final audit reporting problems = 0 across nine hard-constraint assertions.
